description: This file defines an intrusive doubly-linked list template class 'SpdyIntrusiveList' and its associated link class 'SpdyIntrusiveLink' used for embedding list pointers within elements. It provides list operations such as insertion, deletion, splicing, and iteration, optimized for space and performance by avoiding separate node allocations.

classes.name: SpdyIntrusiveLink
classes.description: A base class for embedding link pointers in elements to be stored in an intrusive list.

classes.name: SpdyIntrusiveList
classes.description: A template class implementing a doubly-linked intrusive list with operations for insertion, removal, splicing, and iteration.

methods.name: push_back
methods.description: Insert element at the end of the list.

methods.name: push_front
methods.description: Insert element at the beginning of the list.

methods.name: erase
methods.description: Remove an element from the list given a pointer to the element.

methods.name: begin
methods.description: Return iterator to the first element.

methods.name: end
methods.description: Return iterator to the position past the last element.

methods.name: size
methods.description: Return the number of elements in the list (O(N)).

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Reset the list to empty state.
